note: The reproduction set's one table (ADR 0404). A case is one cause or shape of a kind: uncertifiable (it stands for `causes`, keys of scripts/uncertifiable-causes.mjs, and `weight` is how many results of the rc.17 corpus sweep it stands for), violation or clean (from the pre-release run). `expect` is what its files produce today; `source` is the corpus site it was reduced from. `notReproduced` is the long tail of the same sweep.
